name: runtime
doc:
The cycle collector (DESIGN.md "Память" → "Циклы", runtime/ABI.md 3.8):
trial deletion over the objects of potentially cyclic types only (those
warning W0001 names). ZELL_CYCLES=auto (default) runs it when enough
possible roots were recorded, manual only through CollectCycles, off
disables it (no flags, no recording: plain reference counting).

items.name: CollectCycles
items.doc:
Runs the cycle collector now (on the calling thread) and returns the
number of objects it freed. Their Drop methods run first, before any
of their fields is released. 0 when ZELL_CYCLES=off.
items.summary: Runs the cycle collector now (on the calling thread) and returns the number of objects it freed.

items.name: FreeOSMemory
items.doc: FreeOSMemory returns as much free heap memory to the operating system as possible: the calling thread's empty pages, the free page reserve and cached large mappings (runtime/ABI.md 3.2).
items.summary: FreeOSMemory returns as much free heap memory to the operating system as possible: the calling thread's empty pages, the free page reserve and cached large mappings (runtime/ABI.md 3.2).

members.name: Collected
members.doc: Objects freed by the collector so far.
members.summary: Objects freed by the collector so far.

members.name: Candidates
members.doc:
Possible cycle roots recorded so far (a count of an object of a
cyclic type went down to a value other than zero).
members.summary: Possible cycle roots recorded so far (a count of an object of a cyclic type went down to a value other than zero).

members.name: Examined
members.doc:
Objects examined by all collections (each is in the set reachable
from the roots through cyclic-typed references).
members.summary: Objects examined by all collections (each is in the set reachable from the roots through cyclic-typed references).

members.name: Pending
members.doc: Recorded roots waiting for the next collection.
members.summary: Recorded roots waiting for the next collection.

members.name: Threshold
members.doc:
Auto mode: pending roots that start a collection (adapts to how
much garbage collections find; ZELL_CYCLES_THRESHOLD fixes it).
members.summary: Auto mode: pending roots that start a collection (adapts to how much garbage collections find; ZELL_CYCLES_THRESHOLD fixes it).

members.name: Aborted
members.doc:
Collections abandoned because the examined set exceeded
ZELL_CYCLES_MAX_SCAN objects.
members.summary: Collections abandoned because the examined set exceeded ZELL_CYCLES_MAX_SCAN objects.
